title: Ask Crateway
description: Ask any question about your company's data in your own words. Answers come from your records and only cover the modules you can open.
deleteFailed: The conversation could not be deleted.

welcomeTitle: What would you like to know?
welcomeText: Ask about leads, surveys, quotations, pickups, packing, deliveries and the money behind them: invoices, payments, expenses, costs and profit. Counts, totals, trends, who and what is late.
placeholder: Ask a question, e.g. How many leads did we win last month?
disclaimer: Answers are worked out by AI from your data. Check important figures in the reports.
notConfigured: The assistant needs an AI provider.
notConfiguredHint: Ask an administrator to add an OpenAI or Claude API key in Settings.
